Category volume was led by ai-tech (126 articles), followed by news (98), wellness (70), homelab (58), science (56), local (50), climate (42), design (42), outdoors (13), homestead (12), and scifi (11). Scoring used the dimensional Q/R/L composite (quality, relevance, local) with weights of 0.25, 0.55, and 0.20 respectively.

Pipeline efficiency averaged a noise-to-signal ratio of 2.37 articles fetched per article delivered over 14 runs, with a range of 0.87 to 3.34. The ratio sat within its historical band this week and did not indicate an unusual degree of filtering overhead or unusually clean source material.
